## About Exzelon

Exzelon — NextGen Hires is a specialist recruitment and staffing firm headquartered in
Chicago, Illinois. Exzelon connects skilled professionals with meaningful careers and
helps employers build strong teams quickly, fairly, and in full compliance with
licensing and credentialing requirements. The firm operates across twelve verticals —
Healthcare, Construction, Electrical, Engineering, Manufacturing, Information Technology,
Finance, Accounting, Tax & Legal, Administrative, Marketing, and Distribution — and
staffs each with dedicated, sector-specialist recruiters who understand the credentials,
licensing rules, and hiring norms of their field. Exzelon places candidates in the
Chicago metropolitan area and nationwide, including full-time, contract, temp-to-hire,
part-time, and travel assignments.

## For Employers

Employers engage Exzelon for permanent recruitment, temporary and temp-to-hire staffing,
direct hire, travel assignments with housing and logistics support, and workforce
administration. Every candidate is pre-vetted and compliance-cleared before submission,
so hiring managers review only qualified, ready-to-start talent. To begin, employers
contact Exzelon through the For Clients page (https://www.exzelon.com/for-clients) or
directly by phone or email. Exzelon learns the role requirements and begins matching
pre-vetted candidates right away.

## Frequently Asked Questions — Full Answers

### Is it free for job seekers to use Exzelon?
Yes. Searching jobs, creating a profile, uploading a resume, and applying through Exzelon
is always free for candidates — there are no registration fees, placement fees, or hidden
costs at any stage. Exzelon operates on an employer-funded model: the companies that hire
candidates pay Exzelon for its recruitment services, while job seekers receive recruiter
support, credential guidance, and placement assistance at no personal cost. This model is
standard across the professional staffing industry and means Exzelon's incentives are
aligned with helping candidates find the right role.

### Which industries does Exzelon recruit for?
Exzelon specializes in twelve sectors: Healthcare, Construction, Electrical, Engineering,
Manufacturing, Information Technology, Finance, Accounting, Tax & Legal, Administrative,
Marketing, and Distribution. Each sector has dedicated recruiters who understand its
specific credentials, licensing requirements, and hiring standards — from registered
nurses, LPNs, travel nurses, and allied health professionals in healthcare, to site
supervisors and skilled trades in construction, journeyman and master electricians in
electrical, mechanical and process engineers in engineering, machine operators and
quality inspectors in manufacturing, software, data, cloud, DevOps, and QA professionals
in IT, financial analysts and controllers in finance, staff accountants and bookkeepers
in accounting, CPAs, paralegals, and compliance professionals in tax & legal, executive
assistants and coordinators in administrative, digital marketers and content strategists
in marketing, and warehouse leads and logistics coordinators in distribution.

### How quickly can I be placed?
Placement speed depends on the role and a candidate's credentials, but Exzelon's average
time-to-offer is around 9 days in healthcare and comparable across the other sectors.
Travel and contract roles can move even faster because approval cycles are shorter and
Exzelon maintains pre-vetted talent pools. Candidates can accelerate their own timeline by
completing their profile — resume, experience level, and credentials — before their first
recruiter call, which shortens the pre-screening stage.

### Does Exzelon offer travel and contract assignments?
Yes. Exzelon offers full-time, contract, temp-to-hire, part-time, and travel assignments.
Travel assignments include housing and logistics support so travelers can focus on the
work rather than relocation. Contract and temp-to-hire options give both candidates and
employers flexibility, and are available across all twelve of Exzelon's sectors.

### How does Exzelon handle licensing and compliance?
Exzelon's compliance team manages credentialing, license verification, background checks,
and industry-specific standards so every candidate is fully cleared before day one.
Professional licenses and certifications are verified at the primary source before
placement, background and reference checks are conducted to industry and client
requirements, and full credentialing workflows for healthcare and other regulated roles
are kept current and audit-ready. I-9 and work-authorization checks are completed for
every candidate, and OSHA compliance and safety certifications are tracked for
construction and electrical roles.

### I'm an employer — how do I start hiring with Exzelon?
Visit the For Clients page (https://www.exzelon.com/for-clients) or contact Exzelon
directly at hr@exzelon.com or +1 (773) 644-3571. Exzelon learns the role's
requirements, team, and timeline, then begins matching qualified, pre-vetted candidates
right away — handling sourcing, screening, and compliance so employers review only
ready-to-start talent.

## Compliance Standards

- License Verification: Primary-source verification of every professional license and
  certification before placement.
- Background Screening: Comprehensive background and reference checks in line with
  industry and client requirements.
- Credentialing: Full credentialing workflows for healthcare and regulated roles, kept
  current and audit-ready.
- Right-to-Work: I-9 and work-authorization verification for every candidate placed.
- Safety & OSHA: OSHA compliance and safety certification tracking for construction and
  electrical roles.
- Data Protection: Candidate and client data handled under strict privacy and
  confidentiality standards.
